$comment: Guntha for Maharashtra and Karnataka. A guntha is 1/40 of an acre (a square of 33 ft = 1,089 sq ft). Karnataka RTC extracts state extent as acres.guntas (e.g. 2.10 = 2 acres 10 guntas); Maharashtra 7/12 extracts print hectare-are, while guntha is used in sale talk. Verified by the owner on 2026-10-09 against the official land records (checklist below).
verified_by: repository owner (confirmed 2026-10-09 against Karnataka RTC acres.guntas and Maharashtra 7/12)
verification_checklist: Open a Karnataka RTC (https://landrecords.karnataka.gov.in) and confirm extent is written as acres.guntas with 40 guntas to an acre.
Open a Maharashtra 7/12 (https://bhulekh.mahabhumi.gov.in) or ask a talathi, and confirm 1 guntha = 1/40 acre (about 1.0117 are).
If both hold, set status to verified, put your name in verified_by, update last_verified, and open the PR with the approved-by-owner label.

sources.title: 1acre.in: 1 guntha = 1,089 sq ft (101.17 sq m), Karnataka
